quote:
I was expecting more this is the game of the decade. Performance is **** almost all games released have options now a days and this game has had 12-13 freaking years and the biggest budget ever and it doesn't have different options. 30 fps in 2026 is absolutely insane. its not even stable 30 fps and it feels already in the beginning that is super low 20s fps at many parts.minimum should be stable 40 fps for a slower paced game like gta or ideally 60 fps for all games. Story wise so far I'm let down also and i hope it's gonna pick up real soon (I'm 10 hours in)

I dont know for a game that has sooooooo much money and so much hype and TIME to develop it's so hard to meet expectations. if this was released 4-5 years after gta 5 I would've understood more but I would lie if I would say that im not disappointed in this
